verdict.rationale: Quantization-format support is a fair question for an on-device inference SDK like RunAnywhere, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions FP8, INT4, GPTQ, AWQ, or any other quantized model format. The 'detects the format the model expects' line concerns tool-calling formats, not weight quantization, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can load models quantized in formats like FP8, INT4, GPTQ, or AWQ
